useCases: Ships as a complete, ready-to-run installer — no dependency hunting, no manual patching, no post-install tweaks.
All features come activated out of the box; nothing is gated behind a separate step.
Preconfigured defaults target a working desktop setup on first launch, not a skeleton you have to finish yourself.
readmeSummary: A dotfiles repo should be boring: clone it, run the installer, and get a working desktop without babysitting a wizard.
